# PORA – interior design studio (Košice, Slovakia → worldwide)

> PORA s.r.o. is an interior design studio based in Košice, Slovakia, working in person across Slovakia and online for clients anywhere in the world. It designs interiors of apartments, family houses, cafés, bistros, restaurants and bars, salons, dental clinics and offices, and delivers photorealistic visualisations, construction documents for craftsmen and author's supervision. 80+ completed projects since founding, 20+ of them hospitality and commercial spaces. Tagline: "F***ing cool interiors". Website in Slovak and English.

Key facts:
- Name: PORA (PORA s.r.o., IČO 53834691, DIČ 2121506618, IČ DPH SK2121506618)
- Studio: Námestie osloboditeľov 3/A (building DUETT 1), 040 01 Košice, Slovakia
- Contact: info@pora.sk, +421 903 494 977, https://www.pora.sk/#kontakt (reply within 2 working days, free initial consultation in person or online)
- Languages: Slovak, English
- Team: Tomáš Potočiar (CEO, founder); Mgr. art. Daniel Csúz (COO, Head of design); Mgr. art. Katarína Csúzová, ArtD. (Senior designer)
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/pora_atelier/ · Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/poradizajn/
- Pricing (excl. VAT): Mini package €2,490 (one room / up to 20 m²); Variant 1 "Design" €4,990 (up to 100 m²); Variant 2 "Realisation" from €15,000 depending on project scope (design + construction documents + author's supervision); interior consultations €500/hour; larger homes and commercial spaces quoted individually.
- Scope note: PORA delivers interior design and construction documents for craftsmen ("podklady k realizácii"); it does not prepare building-permit or full architectural design documentation itself – full architectural design of houses and apartments is arranged in cooperation with a partner architecture studio.
- Private clients are never named; private homes are listed as PROJECT 01–16.

## FAQ (English)
### How much does an interior design cost?
The Mini package costs €2,490 (one room or a space up to 20 m²), Variant 1 “Design” €4,990 (up to 100 m²) and Variant 2 “Realisation” from €15,000 depending on the scope of the project. Interior consultations cost €500 per hour. Prices exclude VAT. Larger apartments and houses as well as commercial spaces are quoted individually.

### Do you work outside Košice and Slovakia?
Yes. The studio is based in Košice, Slovakia; we work in person across Slovakia and design online for clients anywhere in the world – consultations, visualisations and documents can all be delivered remotely.

### What do I get as part of the interior design?
Depending on the variant: measuring of the space, layout design, photorealistic visualisations, material selection and a product list. Variant 2 also includes construction documents for craftsmen (electrical and plumbing layouts, joinery specifications, production drawings) and author’s supervision on site.

### Do you also prepare building permit or construction design documentation?
No – our service is interior design, and we deliver construction documents for craftsmen and suppliers. Full architectural design of houses and apartments can be arranged in cooperation with our partner architecture studio.

### Do you design cafés, restaurants and commercial spaces?
Yes. We have completed more than 20 hospitality and commercial spaces – bistros, cafés, restaurants and bars, salons, dental clinics and offices. We handle the concept, the brand in the space, operational flows and durable materials. Commercial spaces are quoted individually.

### How many projects have you completed?
More than 80 completed projects since the studio was founded, over 20 of them hospitality and commercial spaces. 25 selected projects are shown on this website.

### How do we start?
Write to us via the form on this website, at info@pora.sk, or call +421 903 494 977. We will get back to you within 2 working days and arrange a free initial consultation – in person or online.

### Which languages do you work in?
Slovak and English.

## Časté otázky (slovensky)
### Koľko stojí návrh interiéru?
Balík Mini stojí 2 490 € (jedna miestnosť alebo priestor do 20 m²), Variant 1 „Design“ 4 990 € (do 100 m²) a Variant 2 „Realizácia“ od 15 000 € podľa rozsahu projektu. Interiérové konzultácie stoja 500 € za hodinu. Ceny sú bez DPH. Väčšie byty a domy aj komerčné priestory naceňujeme individuálne.

### Pracujete aj mimo Košíc a Slovenska?
Áno. Štúdio sídli v Košiciach, osobne pracujeme po celom Slovensku a online navrhujeme pre klientov kdekoľvek na svete – konzultácie, vizualizácie aj podklady dodáme na diaľku.

### Čo dostanem v rámci návrhu interiéru?
Podľa zvoleného variantu: zameranie priestoru, dispozičné riešenie, fotorealistické vizualizácie, výber materiálov a produktový list. Vo Variante 2 aj podklady k realizácii (schémy elektroinštalácie a vody, stolárske špecifikácie, výrobné výkresy) a autorský dozor na stavbe.

### Vypracujete aj projekt stavby alebo realizačný projekt?
Nie – naša služba je návrh interiéru a dodávame k nemu podklady k realizácii pre remeselníkov a dodávateľov. Kompletnú projekciu domov a bytov vieme zastrešiť v spolupráci s partnerským projekčným štúdiom.

### Navrhujete aj kaviarne, reštaurácie a komerčné priestory?
Áno. Máme za sebou viac ako 20 gastro a komerčných priestorov – bistrá, kaviarne, reštaurácie a bary, salóny, zubné ambulancie aj kancelárie. Riešime koncept, značku v priestore, prevádzkové toky aj odolné materiály. Komerčné priestory naceňujeme individuálne.

### Koľko projektov ste už realizovali?
Od založenia štúdia viac ako 80 realizácií, z toho viac ako 20 gastro a komerčných priestorov. Na webe nájdete 25 vybraných projektov.

### Ako začať spoluprácu?
Napíšte nám cez formulár na webe, na info@pora.sk alebo zavolajte na +421 903 494 977. Ozveme sa do 2 pracovných dní a dohodneme nezáväznú úvodnú konzultáciu – osobne alebo online.

### V akom jazyku komunikujete?
Po slovensky a po anglicky.
